cards.card_text: Sanballat and Tobiah, together with the Arabs, Ammonites and Ashdodites, hear that the gaps in the wall are closing, and they are furious all over again.
cards.verse_text: When Sanballat and Tobiah, together with the Arabs, Ammonites, and Ashdodites, heard that the repair to the walls of Jerusalem was progressing and that the gaps were being closed, they were furious,
